title: Effects of Family Work Shop for Children With Developmental Delays: a Randomized Trial
brief_summary: To identify the therapeutic effects of short-term family-centered work shop for children with developmental delays
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 M/O to 36 M/O children with developmental delays, under regular rehabilitation programs

Exclusion Criteria:

* less than 18 M/O and older than 36 M/O failed to obtain written informed consent
